name: dinner-booking-clarify
description: Two-round clarification: the first choice is unavailable, the scripted user supplies a new time, and the agent books it within the same session.
prompt: Book me a table for two tonight.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check free slots for a given evening.
tools.result: tonight: fully booked; tomorrow: 19:00 and 20:00 free

tools.name: book_table
tools.description: Book a table for a given slot.

scripted_turns.text: Tonight is fully booked. Tomorrow has 19:00 and 20:00 free — would 20:00 work for you?
Booked: a table for two tomorrow at 20:00.
